surfaces.title: Capability modules
surfaces.intro: Capability modules are Server-owned packages. Desktop lists them in overlay chrome. Mobile lists them in the workspace Settings tab. Clients never call the remote registry. Green is ready, not decoration.

surfaces.title: File viewer
surfaces.intro: A readonly inspection window for a Server-owned file or diff. The catalog owns chrome, gutter, line kinds, hunk markers, and syntax token colors. Clients virtualize the line list instead of dumping the file into one text node.

components.title: Inspection window
components.note: Compose the overlay panel. Header carries path and change status. Close returns to the change list. Do not turn this into an editor.

surfaces.title: Git history
surfaces.intro: Mobile history is graph-first: a pinned timestamp column and a horizontally scrollable graph. Selecting a row puts subject, author, branches, and tags in a sticky header. Checkout is a confirmed header action, not a chip tap. Green is selection, not decoration.

components.title: Selected commit
components.note: The sticky header is the only place for commit message, author, refs, and a confirmed checkout. Ref chips are labels. Rows stay timestamp plus graph.

components.title: History row
components.note: Every row is a fixed-width timestamp plus the graph. Selection is an accent tint plus a 2px leading accent rule on the timestamp only. The graph column stays unselected so lane colors stay readable. Hover stays a neutral state layer. When the graph is wider than the pane, only the graph region scrolls horizontally.
